mapper.sql: id, order_id as orderId, product_id as productId, merchant_id as merchantId, product_name as productName, product_image as productImage, product_price as productPrice, quantity, subtotal, specs, create_time as createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, product_id, merchant_id, product_name, product_image, product_price, quantity, subtotal, specs, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{merchantId}, #{productName}, #{productImage}, #{productPrice}, #{quantity}, #{subtotal}, #{specs}, #{createTime})

INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, product_id, merchant_id, product_name, product_image, product_price, quantity, subtotal, specs, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.merchantId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.productImage}, #{item.productPrice}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.subtotal}, #{item.specs}, #{item.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT oi.id, oi.order_id as orderId, oi.product_id as productId, oi.merchant_id as merchantId, oi.product_name as productName, oi.product_image as productImage, oi.product_price as productPrice, oi.quantity, oi.subtotal, oi.specs, oi.create_time as createTime, p.cover_img as productImg, m.shop_name as merchantName, b.name as brandName FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON oi.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
